description: This file defines the SudoRetrievePolicyRevision class, a final immutable command class used to retrieve a specific policy revision by policy ID, without authorization context, within the Eclipse Ditto policy modeling framework.

classes.name: SudoRetrievePolicyRevision
classes.description: Immutable command class for retrieving a policy revision by ID, extending AbstractCommand and implementing SudoCommand interface. Contains static factory methods, JSON parsing, and overrides for equality, hash, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance with specified PolicyId and optional DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, with optional DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the policy ID payload to JSON builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is QUERY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on policyId and superclass, with null and class type checks.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equals, confirms if other object is instance of SudoRetrievePolicyRevision.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hashcode incorporating superclass hash and policyId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation including class name, superclass toString, and policyId.
